title: Kestrel and the Letter
author: H. M. Winterbourne
blurb: Bram Villalobos, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
